My name is Olivia and I'm a fully qualified Veterinary Physiotherapist, Hydrotherapist & accredited clinical educator working in the heart of Dorset, England. I specialise in both Canine and Equine rehabilitation and am passionate about improving animal's lives and supporting their owners. 

This channel is where I will share with you step by step instructional videos, videos of behind the scenes, clinical practice resources and top tips. 
My ultimate aim is to create a veterinary physiotherapy hub of video content that will inform and inspire you. 
I aim to upload a new video each month, so watch this space!

Please subscribe to my channel and join the Vet Physio Centre community.
